resources.string: Exact answers to everyday sums: fuel, battery, currency and more. No model needed.
I have 23 L of water and 5 L jerrycans. How many jerrycans do I need?
How long to drive 240 miles at 60 mph?
Exact answers to everyday sums, with the formula. No model needed.
My power bank is 5,000 mAh at 3.85 V. Can I take it on a plane?
5,000 mAh × 3.85 V ÷ 1000 = 19.25 Wh. Yes, you can take it on a plane: up to 100 Wh is allowed in carry-on baggage (not in checked bags).

• Works out the answer from the numbers in your question and shows the formula.
• Anything else goes to the model as usual.
• It stays out of conversations about health, injuries, danger or people.
• The answer's details say Tool when the calculator wrote it.
• Word problems are English only. Ported from r4to's calculator (BOAR R&D).
